## See what is installed, and what the app loaded

`doctor` checks one folder you name. The question that actually gets asked is
"why is my plugin not in the sidebar?", and the answer needs three things at once:
what is installed, whether each installed copy is valid, and which of them the
running app actually loaded.

```sh
$ dsh-plugin audit --host http://127.0.0.1:54133
dsh-aiignore           0.37.1    loaded       ok
demo-panel             0.3.0     not loaded   ok  — dsh.profile.bundles in /Users/me/.dsh/profiles/desktop/package.json does not list it, and the loader mounts only listed bundles
                                            fix: add "demo-panel" to dsh.profile.bundles in /Users/me/.dsh/profiles/desktop/package.json (or run `dsh plugin add demo-panel`), then restart the app

1 installed plugin(s) are not in the running app:
```

"Not loaded" has three different causes, and `audit` names the one that applies
instead of offering a blanket restart:

- **Not in `dsh.profile.bundles`.** `pnpm add` (or `npm install`) installs the
  package but does not tell the loader to mount it. Add the package name to
  `dsh.profile.bundles` in `~/.dsh/profiles/<profile>/package.json`, or run
  `dsh plugin add <name>`, then restart the app.
- **No `dsh.bundle`.** The package declares `dsh` but no patch file to mount.
  Add `dsh.bundle.patch` to its `package.json` and ship the patch file, then
  reinstall.
- **Listed, but the app predates the install.** The profile is already correct;
  restart the app once to read the new list.

Advisories (`engines.dsh`, README Requirements) are counted apart from problems:
the market index needs them, the loader does not, so they should not bury a plugin
that is actually broken.

`audit` exits `1` when an installed plugin has a hard failure **or** when the
running app did not load at least one installed plugin, so CI can gate on a
profile where the app silently skipped a plugin. It exits `0` when every
installed plugin is loaded and valid. If no graph was read (`--host` omitted),
the loaded column is `?` and only hard failures change the exit code.

`audit --home <dir>` scans a different profile home; both `~/.dsh` and
`~\.dsh` expand. A bare `--home`, or one followed by another flag such as
`--timeout 50` or `--json`, is a missing value rather than a request to scan
`$HOME/.dsh` or a folder literally named after the flag: the command exits `2`,
names `--home`, and prints no profile report.

Without `--host` the loaded column is `?`, because guessing would be worse than
saying nothing. Only packages that declare a `dsh` field are audited — the rest of
`node_modules` is ordinary dependencies, and auditing those is noise.

An installed package whose `package.json` cannot be read is the exception: the
`dsh` field that would mark it as a plugin is in the file that failed to parse.
If its name is still in `dsh.profile.bundles`, `audit` reports a `manifest`
failure naming the unreadable `package.json` and exits `1` instead of treating
the folder as an ordinary dependency. A truncated manifest from an interrupted
install therefore cannot make the plugin disappear from the report, and a valid
sibling plugin is still listed on the same run. The exception stays narrow: a
damaged `package.json` in a package that is neither in `dsh.profile.bundles` nor
readable enough to expose a `dsh` field is still an ordinary dependency and is
skipped, so one broken transitive install does not fail every audit.

A declared bundle can also be missing entirely. If a name stays in
`dsh.profile.bundles` after its `node_modules/<name>` folder is removed (an
interrupted install, or a package deleted by hand), `audit` prints a `missing`
row with an `install` failure naming the absent folder and exits `1`, while
still listing the healthy plugins on the same run. An absent package that the
profile never declared is not an install record, so it is not invented in the
report; a regression test removes the name from the profile and requires the
shipped CLI to exit `0` without printing it.

## Edit a plugin that is already installed

The host already swaps a rebuilt bundle without a page reload: it watches each plugin's entry artifact and reports a `rebuilt` frame on `/plugins/events`. `dev` puts the new file where the host is looking, then **proves** the frame arrived instead of asking you to check by eye.

```sh
npx dsh-plugin dev . --host http://127.0.0.1:54133
```

![dsh-plugin dev printing the revision the app reported](docs/dev.gif)

*Recorded from a real run against the running app: the last line is the revision the app sent back on `/plugins/events`, not a message the tool printed on faith.*

```
demo-aiignore: /work/plugin/client.js -> ~/.dsh/profiles/desktop/node_modules/dsh-aiignore/client.js
initial: copied 163647 bytes at 1:18:43 AM
reloaded dsh-aiignore (rev e0c0230c4fc9)
watching /work/plugin
```

That last line is the whole point: the revision came back from the app's own event stream, so "it reloaded" is a fact, not a hope.

A plugin the running app never loaded cannot be reloaded, and the app says so by leaving it out of the graph it sends first. `dev` reads that graph, so a freshly installed plugin gets the sentence that fixes it instead of a timeout:

```
copied, but not confirmed: the running app has not loaded demo-panel, so it will not report a reload; restart the app once after installing it
```

| Flag | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `--dest <dir>` | write into this installed copy instead of searching `~/.dsh/profiles/*/node_modules/<name>` |
| `--entry <file>` | copy this file instead of `dsh.client.entry`, `client.js`, `lib/client.js` |
| `--build <command>` | run this before each copy (a failed build copies nothing) |
| `--host <url>` | confirm the reload against the app at this URL; without it the copy still happens and the tool says it is unconfirmed |
| `--once` | copy once and exit, for scripts |

Two things it does not do, because the host does not: React state inside the reloaded plugin is lost, and a failed swap does not roll back to the previous bundle.

## Use it in CI

The same checks run as a GitHub Action, so a tag cannot go out on a plugin that would not install:

```yaml
- uses: actions/checkout@v4
- uses: WJDdidi-1/dsh-plugin-toolkit@v1
  with:
    dir: plugin        # the folder holding the plugin's package.json
    command: verify    # pack it, install the tarball, mount the panel
```

`verify` is the default because it is the only check that reads what a user
actually installs: `doctor` reads the working copy, so a `files` list that
forgets `client.js` passes it and fails only after `npm i`.

`command: doctor` stops at the manifest checks (fast, no install), and
`command: index` audits `market/index.json` instead, failing on any version whose
`engines.dsh` is missing or is not a semver range (a malformed value such as
`>=banana`, or a single pinned version such as `0.2.0`, both fail). Pin
`version:` if you would rather not track the latest release.

## Check a plugin you have not cloned

The panel takes three kinds of input: a folder, `owner/repo`, or a GitHub URL.
A bare name is a search, not a guess — it asks GitHub, lists the matches with
their stars, and checks the one you pick. A repository is downloaded once as a
tarball into a temp folder, so nothing is cloned into your workspace and
nothing is installed.

The CLI reads a repository straight from the GitHub API:

```bash
dsh-plugin doctor --remote V1ki/dsh-plugin-subscriptions
```

```text
dsh-plugin doctor: 1 problem(s) in V1ki/dsh-plugin-subscriptions
  ⨯ engines.dsh: engines.dsh is missing, so a host that enforces the range rejects the install as "incompatible with dsh"; declare the range you support, e.g. "engines": { "dsh": ">=0.2.0" }
```

That is the whole reason this mode exists: the plugin hub files failed installs
back into plugin repositories, and the report is a sentence — `plugin install
failed`, `plugin does not support the DSH version in use` — that never names a
file. Reading `package.json` over the API is enough to name it.

What it can see, and what it cannot:

- Manifest checks (`engines.dsh`, `dsh field`, `files`, `dsh.client`,
  `exports`) run on the real `package.json`.
- README checks (`readme`) run on the text GitHub serves: the README must have
  a `Requirements` heading and must state the host range `package.json`
  declares. A repository whose checkout fails `readme` fails the remote check
  too, with the same sentence.
- File checks (does `exports["./client"]` point at a file that exists, does the
  root export `apply`) need the tree. A package that runs `prepack`,
  `prepublishOnly`, `prepare` or `build` publishes files it does not commit, so
  those checks are **skipped with a note** instead of calling a working plugin
  broken.
- Public repositories work anonymously, but GitHub allows 60 requests an hour.
  Export `GH_TOKEN` (or `GITHUB_TOKEN`) to audit more than one or two.

To check a whole list in one pass, put one `owner/repo` per line in a file and
pass it with `--from` (`-` reads standard input):

```sh
$ dsh-plugin audit --remote --from repos.txt
```

Repositories are read four at a time by default. `--jobs N` changes that width;
values above `8` are capped at `8`, and `--jobs 1` walks the list one repository
at a time, the timing the command had before batching. The output — and the
`--json` array — still follows the input list, and every verdict is the one the
sequential run produced, so a diff between two runs compares repositories rather
than scheduling.

When GitHub answers `403` or `429`, the shared quota is gone, so the batch stops
starting new repositories and marks every entry it could not read as
`rate-limited` instead of `clean` or `unreadable`. If the response carries
`x-ratelimit-reset` (or `retry-after`), the reset time is printed with the
verdict, and the remaining entries are reported without another request.

### Will this plugin install on my DSH?

The eight compatibility reports, from four repositories, all end with the same
question. Add `--host <version>` to a remote audit and it answers that question
for one repository. This is the output for `L3n3L/dsh-resume`, a real plugin
whose declared range stops before DSH 0.2.0, checked against the
`0.2.2-alpha.3` canary from the reports. The checked-in sample is a frozen 0.1.3
snapshot, so the line stays true as the upstream repository changes:

```sh
$ dsh-plugin audit --remote L3n3L/dsh-resume --host 0.2.2-alpha.3
incompatible  L3n3L/dsh-resume  0.1.3 (host >=0.1.0-rc.6 <0.2.0-0) [incompatible with dsh 0.2.2-alpha.3; declares ">=0.1.0-rc.6 <0.2.0-0"]

summary: 1 repository — 0 clean, 1 failing (1 problem), 0 unreadable, 0 rate-limited
```

The verdict comes first: `incompatible` means the range in `package.json` does
not accept the host, so the installer rejects the plugin before it unpacks it.
This run exits `1`. The same answer is reproducible without a GitHub request:
the checked-in snapshot under `examples/compatibility-sample/` keeps the 0.1.3
manifest fields that decide compatibility, and its `## Requirements` heading
isolates the host-range answer. This command feeds that snapshot through the
real CLI path:

```sh
$ node scripts/compatibility-sample.mjs
```

(`npm run compatibility` runs the same script.) The test suite runs that
command and compares its output with the block above, so the sample cannot
drift from the formatter or from the README. Running
`dsh-plugin audit --remote L3n3L/dsh-resume --host 0.2.2-alpha.3` without the
sample audits the repository's current default branch instead; a README or
manifest change since 0.1.3 can add another `readme` or manifest failure to the
same row.

The line carries the range `package.json` declares and one of `compatible`,
`incompatible`, or `unknown` against that host version. `unknown` is the honest
answer for a missing or malformed range — there is nothing to compare — while a
range that excludes the host is `incompatible`, counted as failing, and exits
`1`. npm's pre-release rule is part of the answer: `>=0.2.0` does not accept
`0.2.2-alpha.3`, because a range only opts into a pre-release when it names one
of the same `major.minor.patch`. A canary host can therefore be `incompatible`
with a range that will accept the final release. The same flag works in the
batch mode, so one `--from` run answers the whole list:

```sh
$ dsh-plugin audit --remote --from repos.txt --host 0.2.2-alpha.3
```

The compatibility flags are `--remote <owner/repo>` for one repository,
`--from <file>` for a list (`-` reads standard input), `--host <version>` for
the DSH version to compare against, and `--json` for the machine-readable
finding. `--jobs <n>` sets the batch width, and `--patch-dir <dir>` writes the
host-targeted repair for each repository that needs one. The help text lists
the same flags; a test fails if this section names a flag the CLI does not have.

`--host` still names the running app URL for a local `audit`; on `--remote` it
is the DSH version to compare against. With `--json`, each finding gains
`host` and `compatibility` beside `hostRange`.

Each repository gets one line with its verdict — `clean`, `failing`,
`unreadable`, or `rate-limited` — and the run ends with a counted summary:

```text
clean         demo/plugin  1.2.3 (host >=0.2.0)
failing       demo/broken  — engines.dsh: engines.dsh is missing, so a host that enforces the range rejects the install as "incompatible with dsh"
rate-limited  demo/blocked — GitHub rate-limited this request (403) for package.json; set GH_TOKEN or GITHUB_TOKEN to raise the limit; the limit resets at 2026-11-04T20:00:00.000Z
rate-limited  demo/next    — GitHub rate-limited the batch before this repository was read, so it was not requested; the limit resets at 2026-11-04T20:00:00.000Z

summary: 4 repositories — 1 clean, 1 failing (1 problem), 0 unreadable, 2 rate-limited
```

The parenthesised count is the number of failed checks, not the number of failing
repositories: one repository that fails both `engines.dsh` and its client
declaration prints `1 failing (2 problems)`. A repository whose `package.json`
has an empty `dsh` field and no `dsh.bundle.patch` is `failing` here too: the
batch runs the same `dsh field` check as `doctor`, and the `--json` finding

with no `Requirements` heading is treated the same way: the batch asks the same
`readme` question as a checkout, so the row is `failing`, the `--json` finding
names `readme`, and the run exits `1` instead of reporting the repository clean.

# verify-exports-dot

The control for `verify-exports-no-dot`: the same module and `main`, with the
`"."` export restored so the installed bare name imports.

## Requirements

- DeepSeek Harness `>=0.2.0`

# dsh-plugin-toolkit

[![npm](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/dsh-plugin-toolkit)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-plugin-toolkit)
[![downloads](https://img.shields.io/npm/dw/dsh-plugin-toolkit)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-plugin-toolkit)
[![CI](https://github.com/WJDdidi-1/dsh-plugin-toolkit/actions/workflows/ci.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/WJDdidi-1/dsh-plugin-toolkit/actions/workflows/ci.yml)
[![license](https://img.shields.io/npm/l/dsh-plugin-toolkit)](LICENSE)


![dsh-plugin-toolkit](docs/card.png)

English · [中文](./README.zh.md)

Everything a [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) plugin needs between `init` and a version the market index accepts: scaffolding, a test harness for the client bundle, a way to see a change without restarting the app, and a release that does not depend on remembering fourteen steps.

```sh
npx dsh-plugin-toolkit@latest init ./my-panel --name my-panel   # a plugin that already passes the checks
npx dsh-plugin-toolkit@latest verify .                          # pack it, install the tarball, mount the panel
npx dsh-plugin-toolkit@latest release --pr --merge              # tag, wait for npm, update the index, open and merge the PR
```

## The panel

![The Plugin doctor tab, on a plugin that fails two checks](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/WJDdidi-1/dsh-plugin-toolkit/main/docs/panel.png)

The same checks, in the right sidebar: type a folder, an `owner/repo`, or a GitHub link, and it says which one would fail and why. Nothing is installed and nothing is written.

## Three paths

| You are… | Start with | Then |
| --- | --- | --- |
| writing your first plugin | [`init`](#1-write-a-plugin) | `doctor`, `fix`, `verify` |
| changing a panel that is already installed | [`dev`](#2-develop-a-panel) | `mount`, the testkit, `audit` |
| shipping a version | [`verify`](#3-ship-a-version) | `release`, `index` |

It also installs as a plugin. `dsh plugin add dsh-plugin-toolkit` puts a
**插件体检 / Plugin doctor** panel under the conversation and a tab in the right
sidebar. Give it a folder that holds a plugin's `package.json`, or just
`owner/repo` — or a repository name, which it searches GitHub for and lists the
candidates to pick from. It then runs the same checks `verify` runs and says
which one would break the install, with the reason on the line — the same
answers as the CLI, without leaving the app.

```
$ dsh plugin add dsh-plugin-toolkit
```

### 1. Write a plugin

[`init`](#start-from-a-plugin-that-already-passes) writes the files whose absence shows up as a failed first publish — `engines.dsh`, the patch file, a `files` list that ships the code, a client bundle, a test for it, and the CI that runs both. `doctor` then checks the same things without writing anything, and [`verify`](#prove-the-tarball-works-not-just-the-repository) checks the tarball instead of the working copy.

If a plugin already exists, `doctor --fix` turns the failing checks into a
repair plan. It names the file and the edit for every problem, writes nothing
until you add `--write`, and then runs the checks again. `fix --engines` is
still there when the host range is the only thing you need to change.

```sh
npx dsh-plugin-toolkit@latest init ./my-panel --name my-panel
cd my-panel && npm install && npm test && npx dsh-plugin-toolkit@latest doctor .
```

### 2. Develop a panel

A plugin's client code is one file that calls `window.__ModuleLoader__.load({factory})` — there is no module to import, so the usual React test setup does not apply. [`testkit`](#test-a-panel-without-a-browser) supplies the missing half, and [`dev`](#edit-a-plugin-that-is-already-installed) pushes a rebuilt bundle into the running app.

```sh
npx dsh-plugin-toolkit@latest mount ./client.js     # what a user would see, without the app
npx dsh-plugin-toolkit@latest dev . --host http://127.0.0.1:54133
```

### 3. Ship a version

`verify` first (it is the only check that reads the tarball), then `release`, which tags, waits for the registry, writes the index entry with the publish time the registry reports, and — with `--pr --merge` — opens and merges the pull request.

```sh
npx dsh-plugin-toolkit@latest verify .
npx dsh-plugin-toolkit@latest release . --pr --merge
```

## What `verify` actually does

![Five steps, and the failure each one catches](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/WJDdidi-1/dsh-plugin-toolkit/main/docs/pipeline.svg)

The order matters. Packing first means the check reads the file list npm will publish, not the folder you have. Installing the tarball means the root is imported by its bare specifier — the package name the loader uses — not by a file path taken from `main` or `exports["."]`. Node ignores `main` once `exports` exists, so a package whose `exports` map has no `"."` entry fails with `ERR_PACKAGE_PATH_NOT_EXPORTED` at that step even though the file is present. Mounting means the client bundle is actually executed, in jsdom, with a host that records what it registered.

Each step exists because a plugin once got past the step before it and still installed into nothing.

## Why this exists

Releasing one plugin fifteen times taught me three things the ecosystem's tooling does not cover:

1. **A version is not shipped when npm accepts it.** Registry propagation took two to eight minutes every time. `npm view` answered from a stale local cache, so I repeatedly believed a release had failed when it had not — and once believed it had succeeded when the market still could not see it.
2. **The market index is a second release, done by hand.** Each version needs an entry carrying `publishTimestamp` from the registry and `engines.dsh` from the manifest. Forget the range and the index validator rejects the PR with `Engines mismatch` — after the tag is already public.
3. **Reading a manifest is not the same as checking it.** A plugin can have a valid `package.json` and still be uninstallable: `files` that omit the entry the manifest points at, a bundle patch that does not exist, a README that never states the host range it declares.

The five failures behind these checks — a red dot with no panel, a row the host drops, an app that disables every plugin after one unguarded `apply()`, a tab nothing can open, and a checker that was wrong — are written up with their exact error text and how to reproduce each one: [Five plugins that installed and did nothing](https://github.com/WJDdidi-1/dsh-plugin-toolkit/blob/main/docs/why-it-exists.md).

### Four ways a plugin installs and still does nothing

Each of these shipped in a real version of this toolkit before the check below existed. A manifest check passes on all four.

| What you see | What it was | Caught by |
| --- | --- | --- |
| The tab is a red dot and the panel never opens | `exports["."]` pointed at the CLI, so the loader's row had no plugin to apply | `root export` |
| The plugin is installed, the app never serves it | `dsh.client` declared, `exports["./client"]` missing — the host drops the row | `client declaration` |
| The app says the third-party plugin is unsupported and disables all of them | `apply()` read `ctx.webServer` without declaring it; cordis throws instead of returning `undefined` | `verify` (calls `apply` on a context that has no services) |
| The tab registers, and nothing in the UI opens it | `sidebarRightTabs.register()` registers a *type*; the sidebar lists what `tabs.guide()` returns | a testkit test, not `doctor` |

The first three are static: `doctor` and `verify` catch them without the app running. The fourth is a UI contract, so it needs the panel mounted and the registration inspected — that is what [`testkit`](#test-a-panel-without-a-browser) is for.

## Requirements

- Node.js 18 or newer (the registry is read with `fetch`; no runtime dependencies)
- Git and `gh` on `PATH` for the steps that touch GitHub
- DeepSeek Harness `>=0.2.0` — the version whose market index carries `engines.dsh`, which is what makes the range check meaningful
- For `testkit`: `jsdom`, `react` and `react-dom` as dev dependencies (`npm install --save-dev jsdom react react-dom`)

## Start from a plugin that already passes

```sh
$ npx dsh-plugin-toolkit@latest init ./my-panel --name my-panel --title "My panel"
created 8 file(s) in /Users/you/my-panel
  .github/workflows/ci.yml
  .gitignore
  README.md
  client.js
  cordis.patch.yml
  index.js
  package.json
  test/panel.test.mjs

next: npm install && npm test && npm run doctor
```

What you get is not a snippet: it is a plugin whose `doctor` already passes (`engines.dsh`, the patch file, the `files` list), with a client bundle that registers a sidebar tab, a testkit test for it, and a CI workflow that runs both. `init` refuses a directory that is not empty unless you pass `--force`, and refuses a name npm would refuse — those are the two mistakes that cost the most time later.

Every command that takes a path expands a leading `~` before touching the filesystem. The tool, not the shell, expands `~` for these arguments: `cmd` and PowerShell pass `"~/my-panel"` through literally, while a POSIX shell usually expands it first. `init '~/my-panel' --name my-panel` writes into your home directory (the same files `init ~/my-panel` writes on a POSIX shell), and `doctor '~/my-panel'` reads it back. The Windows spelling `~\my-panel` works too; a directory literally named `~` is never created.

## Where it lives

The checker is docked **under the conversation**, above the input bar: a single
row, collapsed by default. Open it and it carries the whole guide — who it is
for, how to use it, what each check means, and what it cannot tell you — plus
the folder field and the results. The same panel is also a **Plugin doctor** tab
in the right sidebar, for when the conversation is busy.

The panel speaks both languages and opens in Chinese; the 中文 / EN switch sits
in the dock's header row (and in the sidebar tab) and the choice is remembered.

Look at it without the app:

```sh
node scripts/preview.mjs /tmp/panel.html   # collapsed, open, with a result, and the tab
```

## Test a panel without a browser

A plugin's client code is one file that calls `window.__ModuleLoader__.load({factory})` — there is no module to import, so the usual React test setup does not apply. `testkit` supplies the missing half: a DOM, the real React, and a host context that records what the panel registers.

```sh
npm install --save-dev jsdom react react-dom
```

```js
import { mountClient, createFetch } from 'dsh-plugin-toolkit/testkit';

const panel = await mountClient({
  file: 'client.js',
  copy: { 'my-plugin': { title: 'My panel' } },
  fetch: createFetch({
    '/my-plugin/report': { body: { score: 71, noise: 3 } },
    '/my-plugin/apply': () => ({ status: 201, body: { score: 92 } }),
  }),
});

await panel.click('[data-testid="optimize"]');
console.assert(panel.text().includes('92'), 'the score on screen did not move');
console.assert(panel.must('[role="status"]').textContent.includes('92'));
await panel.unmount();
```

`unmount()` is async: it lets React finish the work its own unmount schedules before the DOM goes away. Skipping the `await` surfaces as `ReferenceError: window is not defined` *after* the test has already passed, which is a confusing way to learn it.

What you get back: `text()`, `html()`, `query(selector)`, `must(selector)` (throws with the rendered HTML when it misses), `click(selector)`, `type(selector, value)`, `press(selector, key)`, `focus`, `attributes(selector)`, `snapshot(dir, name)` for a normalised DOM baseline, and `host` for assertions about what the bundle registered.

### Keep a visual baseline

The DOM is the baseline: normalising class order and whitespace gives a file that fails for the reasons a screenshot would — a lost label, a control that stopped rendering — and can be reviewed in a diff instead of by eye.

```js
import { expectSnapshot } from 'dsh-plugin-toolkit/testkit';

const panel = await mountClient({ file: 'client.js' });
expectSnapshot(panel.html(), '__snapshots__', 'panel');   // throws with the element that moved
await panel.unmount();
```

First run writes nothing: it tells you to re-run with `UPDATE_SNAPSHOTS=1`, so a baseline is always a decision, never a side effect. That rerun writes the normalised HTML and returns `{ status: 'written' }`; later runs return `same` or fail with the element that moved.

### Check what assistive tech sees

```js
panel.expectAria('[role="tab"][aria-selected="true"]', { label: 'Protection', selected: 'true' });
assert.match(panel.must('[role="status"]').textContent, /Score moved 71 → 77/);
```

`expectAria()` compares the attributes a screen reader actually reads — `role`,
`label`, `live`, `selected`, `expanded`, `checked`, `pressed`, `disabled` — and
names the one that differs:

```
[aria-live="polite"]: expected aria text to be "9", but it is "0"
```

A missing attribute is reported as `nothing`, not as an empty string, because
those are different bugs. `panel.aria(selector)` returns the same object when you
want to assert on it yourself.

`must()` throws with the rendered markup when the selector misses, which is the difference between "the assertion failed" and "here is what the user actually got".

Every example below is a file in this repository, run by CI, and the output shown is the output it prints:

| Example | What it shows |
| --- | --- |
| `node examples/mount-a-bundle.mjs` | mount a real bundle, read the text, click, read it again |
| `node examples/route-stubs.mjs` | answer the routes a panel asks for, and assert on the requests |
| `node examples/baseline.mjs` | a DOM baseline compared on every run |
| `node examples/aria.mjs` | what assistive tech sees |

```sh
$ node examples/mount-a-bundle.mjs
Demo panel Count 0 0
Demo panel Count 1 1
```

```sh
$ node examples/route-stubs.mjs
Score 71
asked for: 1 route(s), undeclared route answers 404
```

To look at a bundle by hand:

```sh
npx dsh-plugin mount ./client.js            # print the text a user would see
npx dsh-plugin mount ./client.js --html     # print the markup
```

That is how the AIignore panel was checked before release: the real bundle, mounted in Node, against a stubbed `/aiignore/*`:

```
$ npx dsh-plugin mount ../ai-context-doctor/plugin/client.js
AIignore No workspace yet Could not read the report …
```

## Put the badge on a plugin that passes

If `verify` passes on your plugin, this badge says so and links back here:

```md
[![checked with dsh-plugin-toolkit](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/WJDdidi-1/dsh-plugin-toolkit/main/docs/badge.svg)](https://github.com/WJDdidi-1/dsh-plugin-toolkit)
```

It is a claim, not a decoration: add it only when `dsh-plugin verify .` exits 0.

## Start from the example

[`dsh-plugin-example`](https://github.com/WJDdidi-1/dsh-plugin-example) is a ~70-line plugin: one sidebar tab, two languages, one behaviour test, CI that runs `verify` through the composite action. It is the shape this toolkit expects, so it is also the fastest way to see whether the toolkit fits your plugin. It is a GitHub template too: **Use this template** starts you on a plugin whose first publish already passes.

```sh
dsh plugin add dsh-plugin-example
```

## See what is installed, and what the app loaded

`doctor` checks one folder you name. The question that actually gets asked is
"why is my plugin not in the sidebar?", and the answer needs three things at once:
what is installed, whether each installed copy is valid, and which of them the
running app actually loaded.

```sh
$ dsh-plugin audit --host http://127.0.0.1:54133
dsh-aiignore           0.37.1    loaded       ok
demo-panel             0.3.0     not loaded   ok  — dsh.profile.bundles in /Users/me/.dsh/profiles/desktop/package.json does not list it, and the loader mounts only listed bundles
                                            fix: add "demo-panel" to dsh.profile.bundles in /Users/me/.dsh/profiles/desktop/package.json (or run `dsh plugin add demo-panel`), then restart the app

1 installed plugin(s) are not in the running app:
```

"Not loaded" has three different causes, and `audit` names the one that applies
instead of offering a blanket restart:

- **Not in `dsh.profile.bundles`.** `pnpm add` (or `npm install`) installs the
  package but does not tell the loader to mount it. Add the package name to
  `dsh.profile.bundles` in `~/.dsh/profiles/<profile>/package.json`, or run
  `dsh plugin add <name>`, then restart the app.
- **No `dsh.bundle`.** The package declares `dsh` but no patch file to mount.
  Add `dsh.bundle.patch` to its `package.json` and ship the patch file, then
  reinstall.
- **Listed, but the app predates the install.** The profile is already correct;
  restart the app once to read the new list.

Advisories (`engines.dsh`, README Requirements) are counted apart from problems:
the market index needs them, the loader does not, so they should not bury a plugin
that is actually broken.

`audit` exits `1` when an installed plugin has a hard failure **or** when the
running app did not load at least one installed plugin, so CI can gate on a
profile where the app silently skipped a plugin. It exits `0` when every
installed plugin is loaded and valid. If no graph was read (`--host` omitted),
the loaded column is `?` and only hard failures change the exit code.

`audit --home <dir>` scans a different profile home; both `~/.dsh` and
`~\.dsh` expand. A bare `--home`, or one followed by another flag such as
`--timeout 50` or `--json`, is a missing value rather than a request to scan
`$HOME/.dsh` or a folder literally named after the flag: the command exits `2`,
names `--home`, and prints no profile report.

Without `--host` the loaded column is `?`, because guessing would be worse than
saying nothing. Only packages that declare a `dsh` field are audited — the rest of
`node_modules` is ordinary dependencies, and auditing those is noise.

An installed package whose `package.json` cannot be read is the exception: the
`dsh` field that would mark it as a plugin is in the file that failed to parse.
If its name is still in `dsh.profile.bundles`, `audit` reports a `manifest`
failure naming the unreadable `package.json` and exits `1` instead of treating
the folder as an ordinary dependency. A truncated manifest from an interrupted
install therefore cannot make the plugin disappear from the report, and a valid
sibling plugin is still listed on the same run. The exception stays narrow: a
damaged `package.json` in a package that is neither in `dsh.profile.bundles` nor
readable enough to expose a `dsh` field is still an ordinary dependency and is
skipped, so one broken transitive install does not fail every audit.

A declared bundle can also be missing entirely. If a name stays in
`dsh.profile.bundles` after its `node_modules/<name>` folder is removed (an
interrupted install, or a package deleted by hand), `audit` prints a `missing`
row with an `install` failure naming the absent folder and exits `1`, while
still listing the healthy plugins on the same run. An absent package that the
profile never declared is not an install record, so it is not invented in the
report; a regression test removes the name from the profile and requires the
shipped CLI to exit `0` without printing it.

## Edit a plugin that is already installed

The host already swaps a rebuilt bundle without a page reload: it watches each plugin's entry artifact and reports a `rebuilt` frame on `/plugins/events`. `dev` puts the new file where the host is looking, then **proves** the frame arrived instead of asking you to check by eye.

```sh
npx dsh-plugin dev . --host http://127.0.0.1:54133
```

![dsh-plugin dev printing the revision the app reported](docs/dev.gif)

*Recorded from a real run against the running app: the last line is the revision the app sent back on `/plugins/events`, not a message the tool printed on faith.*

```
demo-aiignore: /work/plugin/client.js -> ~/.dsh/profiles/desktop/node_modules/dsh-aiignore/client.js
initial: copied 163647 bytes at 1:18:43 AM
reloaded dsh-aiignore (rev e0c0230c4fc9)
watching /work/plugin
```

That last line is the whole point: the revision came back from the app's own event stream, so "it reloaded" is a fact, not a hope.

A plugin the running app never loaded cannot be reloaded, and the app says so by leaving it out of the graph it sends first. `dev` reads that graph, so a freshly installed plugin gets the sentence that fixes it instead of a timeout:

```
copied, but not confirmed: the running app has not loaded demo-panel, so it will not report a reload; restart the app once after installing it
```

| Flag | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `--dest <dir>` | write into this installed copy instead of searching `~/.dsh/profiles/*/node_modules/<name>` |
| `--entry <file>` | copy this file instead of `dsh.client.entry`, `client.js`, `lib/client.js` |
| `--build <command>` | run this before each copy (a failed build copies nothing) |
| `--host <url>` | confirm the reload against the app at this URL; without it the copy still happens and the tool says it is unconfirmed |
| `--once` | copy once and exit, for scripts |

Two things it does not do, because the host does not: React state inside the reloaded plugin is lost, and a failed swap does not roll back to the previous bundle.

## Use it in CI

The same checks run as a GitHub Action, so a tag cannot go out on a plugin that would not install:

```yaml
- uses: actions/checkout@v4
- uses: WJDdidi-1/dsh-plugin-toolkit@v1
  with:
    dir: plugin        # the folder holding the plugin's package.json
    command: verify    # pack it, install the tarball, mount the panel
```

`verify` is the default because it is the only check that reads what a user
actually installs: `doctor` reads the working copy, so a `files` list that
forgets `client.js` passes it and fails only after `npm i`.

`command: doctor` stops at the manifest checks (fast, no install), and
`command: index` audits `market/index.json` instead, failing on any version whose
`engines.dsh` is missing or is not a semver range (a malformed value such as
`>=banana`, or a single pinned version such as `0.2.0`, both fail). Pin
`version:` if you would rather not track the latest release.

## Check a plugin you have not cloned

The panel takes three kinds of input: a folder, `owner/repo`, or a GitHub URL.
A bare name is a search, not a guess — it asks GitHub, lists the matches with
their stars, and checks the one you pick. A repository is downloaded once as a
tarball into a temp folder, so nothing is cloned into your workspace and
nothing is installed.

The CLI reads a repository straight from the GitHub API:

```bash
dsh-plugin doctor --remote V1ki/dsh-plugin-subscriptions
```

```text
dsh-plugin doctor: 1 problem(s) in V1ki/dsh-plugin-subscriptions
  ⨯ engines.dsh: engines.dsh is missing, so a host that enforces the range rejects the install as "incompatible with dsh"; declare the range you support, e.g. "engines": { "dsh": ">=0.2.0" }
```

That is the whole reason this mode exists: the plugin hub files failed installs
back into plugin repositories, and the report is a sentence — `plugin install
failed`, `plugin does not support the DSH version in use` — that never names a
file. Reading `package.json` over the API is enough to name it.

What it can see, and what it cannot:

- Manifest checks (`engines.dsh`, `dsh field`, `files`, `dsh.client`,
  `exports`) run on the real `package.json`.
- README checks (`readme`) run on the text GitHub serves: the README must have
  a `Requirements` heading and must state the host range `package.json`
  declares. A repository whose checkout fails `readme` fails the remote check
  too, with the same sentence.
- File checks (does `exports["./client"]` point at a file that exists, does the
  root export `apply`) need the tree. A package that runs `prepack`,
  `prepublishOnly`, `prepare` or `build` publishes files it does not commit, so
  those checks are **skipped with a note** instead of calling a working plugin
  broken.
- Public repositories work anonymously, but GitHub allows 60 requests an hour.
  Export `GH_TOKEN` (or `GITHUB_TOKEN`) to audit more than one or two.

To check a whole list in one pass, put one `owner/repo` per line in a file and
pass it with `--from` (`-` reads standard input):

```sh
$ dsh-plugin audit --remote --from repos.txt
```

Repositories are read four at a time by default. `--jobs N` changes that width;
values above `8` are capped at `8`, and `--jobs 1` walks the list one repository
at a time, the timing the command had before batching. The output — and the
`--json` array — still follows the input list, and every verdict is the one the
sequential run produced, so a diff between two runs compares repositories rather
than scheduling.

When GitHub answers `403` or `429`, the shared quota is gone, so the batch stops
starting new repositories and marks every entry it could not read as
`rate-limited` instead of `clean` or `unreadable`. If the response carries
`x-ratelimit-reset` (or `retry-after`), the reset time is printed with the
verdict, and the remaining entries are reported without another request.

### Will this plugin install on my DSH?

The eight compatibility reports, from four repositories, all end with the same
question. Add `--host <version>` to a remote audit and it answers that question
for one repository. This is the output for `L3n3L/dsh-resume`, a real plugin
whose declared range stops before DSH 0.2.0, checked against the
`0.2.2-alpha.3` canary from the reports. The checked-in sample is a frozen 0.1.3
snapshot, so the line stays true as the upstream repository changes:

```sh
$ dsh-plugin audit --remote L3n3L/dsh-resume --host 0.2.2-alpha.3
incompatible  L3n3L/dsh-resume  0.1.3 (host >=0.1.0-rc.6 <0.2.0-0) [incompatible with dsh 0.2.2-alpha.3; declares ">=0.1.0-rc.6 <0.2.0-0"]

summary: 1 repository — 0 clean, 1 failing (1 problem), 0 unreadable, 0 rate-limited
```

The verdict comes first: `incompatible` means the range in `package.json` does
not accept the host, so the installer rejects the plugin before it unpacks it.
This run exits `1`. The same answer is reproducible without a GitHub request:
the checked-in snapshot under `examples/compatibility-sample/` keeps the 0.1.3
manifest fields that decide compatibility, and its `## Requirements` heading
isolates the host-range answer. This command feeds that snapshot through the
real CLI path:

```sh
$ node scripts/compatibility-sample.mjs
```

(`npm run compatibility` runs the same script.) The test suite runs that
command and compares its output with the block above, so the sample cannot
drift from the formatter or from the README. Running
`dsh-plugin audit --remote L3n3L/dsh-resume --host 0.2.2-alpha.3` without the
sample audits the repository's current default branch instead; a README or
manifest change since 0.1.3 can add another `readme` or manifest failure to the
same row.

The line carries the range `package.json` declares and one of `compatible`,
`incompatible`, or `unknown` against that host version. `unknown` is the honest
answer for a missing or malformed range — there is nothing to compare — while a
range that excludes the host is `incompatible`, counted as failing, and exits
`1`. npm's pre-release rule is part of the answer: `>=0.2.0` does not accept
`0.2.2-alpha.3`, because a range only opts into a pre-release when it names one
of the same `major.minor.patch`. A canary host can therefore be `incompatible`
with a range that will accept the final release. The same flag works in the
batch mode, so one `--from` run answers the whole list:

```sh
$ dsh-plugin audit --remote --from repos.txt --host 0.2.2-alpha.3
```

The compatibility flags are `--remote <owner/repo>` for one repository,
`--from <file>` for a list (`-` reads standard input), `--host <version>` for
the DSH version to compare against, and `--json` for the machine-readable
finding. `--jobs <n>` sets the batch width, and `--patch-dir <dir>` writes the
host-targeted repair for each repository that needs one. The help text lists
the same flags; a test fails if this section names a flag the CLI does not have.

`--host` still names the running app URL for a local `audit`; on `--remote` it
is the DSH version to compare against. With `--json`, each finding gains
`host` and `compatibility` beside `hostRange`.

Each repository gets one line with its verdict — `clean`, `failing`,
`unreadable`, or `rate-limited` — and the run ends with a counted summary:

```text
clean         demo/plugin  1.2.3 (host >=0.2.0)
failing       demo/broken  — engines.dsh: engines.dsh is missing, so a host that enforces the range rejects the install as "incompatible with dsh"
rate-limited  demo/blocked — GitHub rate-limited this request (403) for package.json; set GH_TOKEN or GITHUB_TOKEN to raise the limit; the limit resets at 2026-11-04T20:00:00.000Z
rate-limited  demo/next    — GitHub rate-limited the batch before this repository was read, so it was not requested; the limit resets at 2026-11-04T20:00:00.000Z

summary: 4 repositories — 1 clean, 1 failing (1 problem), 0 unreadable, 2 rate-limited
```

The parenthesised count is the number of failed checks, not the number of failing
repositories: one repository that fails both `engines.dsh` and its client
declaration prints `1 failing (2 problems)`. A repository whose `package.json`
has an empty `dsh` field and no `dsh.bundle.patch` is `failing` here too: the
batch runs the same `dsh field` check as `doctor`, and the `--json` finding
carries that failure even though no patch path was declared to check. A README
with no `Requirements` heading is treated the same way: the batch asks the same
`readme` question as a checkout, so the row is `failing`, the `--json` finding

evidence.readmeExcerpt:
# pamper

> 给 [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai) 的 [dsh-pet](https://github.com/PC2005-cloud/dsh-pet) 插件扩展**新形象**的工程：把 [aboutme-pets](https://github.com/hunmer/aboutme-pets) 商店的 WebP 精灵图动画转换成透明 WebM，并把[小小桌宠](https://github.com/yshuang722-spec/xiaoxiao-zhuochong)（xiaoxiao-zhuochong）的现成透明 WebM 规范化，统一下载/生成为 dsh-pet 可直接加载的 **pet pack**。装好后，**8 个新形象 + dsh-pet 内置的蓝毛小女仆**可以同屏出现。

- **这不是一个独立的桌宠程序**，而是 dsh-pet 的「形象包（pet pack）」生产 + 安装工具链。
- 产出 **8 个新 pet pack**：
  - aboutme 系列（精灵图转 WebM）：**白龙娘**、**橙发书娘**、**紫发猫耳娘**；
  - xiaoxiao 系列（现成 WebM 规范化）：**橙毛大小姐**、**黄毛该溜子**、**白毛小龙娘**、**黑毛小狐狸**、**奶茶千金**。
- **8 个新 pack 默认 `display=none`（不显示）**：首次安装或每次开机**只会看到 dsh-pet 内置的蓝毛小女仆一只**；8 个形象都在「设置 → 桌宠配置 → 种类」里列着，想显示哪只就把它的「显示位置」改成 仅桌面/仅浏览器/两者并保存。开启后可同屏 9 个形象。
- 可选补丁：给 dsh-pet 的桌面窗口与网页 overlay 右键菜单加「退出回家」——点一下让**这一只**退出（display 置 none），其它宠物不受影响，可在设置页重新开启。
- 运行期补丁（`node scripts/patch-dsh-pet.mjs`）：主菜单新增 **「宠爱」** 入口（直接打开桌宠配置）、设置页「种类」按型号分组（deepseek / GPT / Claude / Gemini / kimi / 豆包 / 其他）、内置宠物改名 **大肥鱼**、每只宠物右键 **「退出回家」**。
- 两个预览页：`preview/`（aboutme 4 形象精灵图舞台）与 `preview/all-characters.html`（8 个新形象本地 WebM 卡片）。
- 素材**优先读本地**（`D:\PC\DSH\桌面宠物源代码\pet素材` 与 `...\xiaoxiao-zhuochong桌面源代码`），本地齐全时可完全离线构建；本地缺失才回退 jsDelivr / raw.githubusercontent。
- 纯 Node.js 脚本（零 npm 依赖）+ ffmpeg，Windows 上一键构建、安装、卸载。

> **项目最终位置：`D:\PC\DSH\pamper`。** 下文命令均以该项目根目录为当前目录执行。

### 收录到社区插件市场（awesome-dsh-plugin）

已向 `LingHXiao/awesome-dsh-plugin` 提交收录 PR：

- PR：https://github.com/LingHXiao/awesome-dsh-plugin/pull/2
- 合并后，dsh-market 的「发现」会自动抓取该目录（通常一天内），即可搜索 **Ai-nice/dsh-pamper** 并一键安装。

> 网络无法访问 GitHub raw 时（安装报 TLS/无法连接 raw.githubusercontent.com），请用 jsDelivr 的 tgz 直链安装：
> ```text
> https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/Ai-nice/dsh-pamper@main/plugin-tarballs/dsh-pamper.tgz
> ```

## DSH 插件市场（自定义索引）

官方目前**没有公共插件索引**；其他插件也是通过「索引源」被发现。添加下面这个索引地址后，就能在插件市场里直接搜索并安装 **pamper**：

```text
https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Ai-nice/dsh-pamper/main/market-index.json
```

步骤：

1. 打开 DSH 侧栏 **插件**；
2. 若没有「发现」标签页：在实验性插件中启用 **自定义插件索引**（`@deepseek-ai/dsh-experimental-plugin-market-bundle`）；
3. **发现 → 添加索引源**，粘贴上面的 URL；
4. 搜索 **pamper**，点安装（包名 `dsh-pamper`，来自 GitHub 仓库 `plugins/dsh-pamper`）。

> 安装的是动作库插件（发现页动作按需加载的后端）。宠爱页面的 UI 补丁仍由项目里的 `scripts/patch-dsh-pet.mjs` 提供；基础形象包在 Release 的 `pets-base.zip`。

## GitHub 轻量发布 / 快速安装（三层结构）

本项目已按「轻仓库 + Release 基础包 + 联网按需动作」整理：

| 层 | 内容 | 大约体积 | 放哪里 |
|---|---|---:|---|
| ① 轻量仓库 | 代码、脚本、插件、目录、预览、文档 | 约 12–15 MB | 主 GitHub 仓库 |
| ② 基础形象 | 8 个 pack 的预转换 WebM | 约 203 MB | GitHub Release：`pets-base.zip` |
| ③ 完整动作库 | 819 个动作的预转换 WebM | 约 0.9 GB | 单独的 assets 仓库（CDN/jsDelivr） |

用户安装：

```powershell
git clone https://github.com/Ai-nice/dsh-pamper.git
cd pamper
node scripts/install-lite.mjs   # 自动从 Release 下载 pets-base.zip 并安装
# 再在 DSH 里安装 plugins/dsh-pamper（一次）
```

之后打开 **宠爱 → 发现**，点动作「加载」时插件会从 `assetBaseUrl` 下载对应 WebM 到本地缓存再安装，**不需要 ffmpeg、不需要下载整个素材库**。

发布者步骤（准备主仓库、assets 仓库、Release、填写地址）见 [docs/publish-github.md](docs/publish-github.md)（打包命令：`node scripts/pack-release.mjs`）。



## 宠爱入口 / 型号分组 / 改名（运行期补丁）

`node scripts/patch-dsh-pet.mjs` 给**已安装的 dsh-pet** 打一组运行期补丁（幂等，自动备份 `*.dshpet-backup`；dsh-pet 升级后重跑）：

| 改动 | 效果 |
| --- | --- |
| 主菜单「宠爱」 | 左侧主菜单新增「宠爱」；页面顶部两个标签：**角色**（角色预览卡片 + 显示/隐藏开关）与 **桌宠配置**（原有配置页，完全不变） |
| 型号分组 | 设置页「种类」条按型号分组：**deepseek / GPT / Claude / Gemini / kimi / 豆包 / 其他**（豆包暂空）；同组可放多只不同形象，例如 GPT=白龙娘+白毛小龙娘，Claude=橙发书娘+橙毛大小姐 |
| 内置改名 | 内置蓝毛小女仆显示名改为 **大肥鱼**，并把 main 设为桌面显示，保证开机有一只 |
| 退出回家 | 每只宠物右键菜单新增「退出回家」，点一下只让这一只退出（display 置 none），设置页可再开启 |

分组归属（改 `config/xiaoxiao.mjs` / `config/characters.mjs` 的位置不影响这个映射；映射写在补丁脚本里）：

| 型号 | 形象 |
| --- | --- |
| deepseek | 大肥鱼（main，内置） |
| GPT | aboutme-dragon 白龙娘、xiaoxiao-bailong 白毛小龙娘 |
| Claude | aboutme-claude 橙发书娘、xiaoxiao-ojousama 橙毛大小姐 |
| Gemini | aboutme-gemini 紫发猫耳娘 |
| kimi | xiaoxiao-huangmao 黄毛该溜子 |
| 豆包 | （暂空） |
| 其他 | xiaoxiao-heihu 黑毛小狐狸、xiaoxiao-naicha 奶茶千金 |

```powershell
node scripts/patch-dsh-pet.mjs            # 应用全部补丁
node scripts/patch-dsh-pet.mjs --check    # 检查状态
node scripts/patch-dsh-pet.mjs --revert   # 还原（含 main-config 与包内 config.jsonc）
```

> 补丁改的是 dsh-pet 插件运行期文件（`runtime/electron-helper/sprite/menu.js` 与 `lib/client.js`）+ 用户 `main-config.jsonc`；插件升级/重装会覆盖，需要重跑。刷新 DSH 页面（Ctrl+F5）后生效。
- 「宠爱」页的**角色页**：右上角是官方同款圆形「刷新」图标 + 深色「＋ 添加角色 ▾」按钮；副标题为「一碗碗大米饭就是对你的宠爱…」；「角色 / 桌宠配置」为胶囊分段切换。统计栏保持**一行**：**「N 位角色 · M 个正在桌面陪伴」**（随开关实时变化）+「刷新列表 / 全部开启 / 全部隐藏」三个按钮（白底描边，鼠标悬停变黑底白字，点击即执行）。每个角色一张预览卡（角色图 + 「N 个动作 · 独立角色项目」+ 右上角「详情」文字链），**三列网格**、可纵向滚动；与官方插件页一致的开关（40×22 胶囊轨道 + 18px 白色圆形圆钮；开启=深黑轨道，关闭=浅灰轨道，0.2s 平滑滑动）控制显示（开启 = 只在桌面显示并只开该角色第一只实例，关闭 = 全部实例隐藏），卡片左上角显示「已隐藏」。点「详情」会切到「桌宠配置」并自动选中这个角色。
- 「宠爱」页的**桌宠配置页**：与「设置 → 桌宠配置」完全同一套页面，功能不变（分组、实例、大小、位置、显示方式、保存等），宽度自适应页面。
## 发现：动作按需加载（dsh-pamper 插件）

除了「角色 / 桌宠配置」，宠爱页新增 **「发现」** 第三页：从 `assets/pet-store/` 的完整动作库（4 角色 / 6 动作包 / **819 个动作**：小女仆 268、白龙娘 285、橙发书娘 166、紫发猫耳娘 100）里挑动作，按需转成透明 WebM 并加载进对应形象。

- **动作库与已安装分离**：`assets/pet-store/` 保存原始精灵图；未加载的动作不转换、不安装，只出现在发现页。
- **三种加载粒度**：单个动作、整分类（「加载本分类」）、整角色（「加载该角色全部」）；已加载的动作显示为「已加载」并禁用按钮。
- **按需转换**：点击加载时由本地插件调用 ffmpeg 把精灵图转成 VP9 透明 WebM（单个动作约 10–60 秒，长动作更久），写入对应 pack 的 animation 目录并合并 config，最后自动通知 dsh-pet 重载。
- **小女仆 = 大肥鱼**：动作库里的小女仆就是主形象「大肥鱼」，不再单独创建 `aboutme-maid`；发现页加载小女仆动作会直接写进 main（`main-config.jsonc` + `main-animation/`），同一角色只保留一个形象。

### 插件安装

发现页的后端是项目内的小型 DSH host 插件 `plugins/dsh-pamper/`（注册 `/dsh-pamper-7462/*` 路由）。安装一次即可：

```powershell
# 在 DSH 里通过 plugin_manager install_bundle 安装（target 用绝对路径）
```

## 效果与工作原理

dsh-pet 会扫描 `%DSH_HOME%\dsh-pet\pet\` 目录，把每一组

```
pet\<前缀>-config.json       ← pet pack 配置（宠物实例 + 动画池）
pet\<前缀>-animation\*.webm  ← 该形象专属的透明动画素材
pet\<前缀>-avatar.png        ← 可选：角色头像（xiaoxiao 系列自带）
```

识别为一个新的「种类」（素材根 = 文件名前缀）。安装本项目后，DSH 设置页的「桌宠配置 → 种类」条里会多出 8 个可切换的种类，宠物列表里也对应多出 8 只实例；dsh-pet 自带的蓝毛小女仆仍在 `main` 条目里，不受影响。

### 默认显示策略：只开一只（display=none）

本项目的 8 个 pack 默认 **`display = none`（都不显示）**。因此：

- 首次安装、以及之后每次开机，**只会看到 dsh-pet 内置的蓝毛小女仆一只**（本机 `main` 当前配置为仅桌面），不会满屏；
- 8 个种类仍完整列在「设置 → 桌宠配置 → 种类」里（`display=none` 不影响种类列表），实例也在宠物列表里；
- 想显示某个形象：**设置 → 桌宠配置 → 种类** 里选中它 → 在「宠物配置」把 **显示位置** 从「都不显示」改成 **仅桌面 / 仅浏览器 / 两者** → 点「保存」。桌面端保存后 Helper 会重载/重启，宠物窗口随之出现；
- 8 个全部开启时共 9 个形象可同屏；桌面模式实际开几个透明窗由各实例的 `display` 决定（只在浏览器就选「仅浏览器」，避免开太多 Electron 窗口）。

> 若你把 `main` 也改成了 `both`/`web`，浏览器 overlay 会多出蓝毛小女仆一只；以上按本机当前 `main-config.jsonc`（仅桌面）描述。

安装后即可使用 dsh-pet 的全部互动：拖拽/抛掷、点击回应、余额动画、工作状态联动、碎碎念、多宠物互撞等。aboutme 三个形象默认关闭了余额与碎碎念（避免额外模型调用），工作状态联动开启；xiaoxiao 五个形象默认关闭余额/碎碎念/工作状态联动（它们的动画池较小，以随机小动作与点击回应为主）。

| 本地素材源（**可选**） | 默认 `D:\PC\DSH\桌面宠物源代码` | 其中 `pet素材\`（aboutme-pets 仓库快照，约 1.4 GiB 精灵图）与 `xiaoxiao-zhuochong桌面源代码\`（小小桌宠源码与成品 WebM）。可用环境变量 `DESKTOP_PET_SOURCE_ROOT` 指向别处；**本地齐全时可完全离线构建** |
| 网络（**可选**） | 本地素材缺失时需要 | 从 jsDelivr CDN 下载商店目录/精灵图，失败自动回退 raw.githubusercontent；xiaoxiao 素材没有网络回退，必须本地存在 |
| DSH_HOME | 默认 `C:\Users\Ai-nice\.dsh` | 若设置了环境变量 `DSH_HOME`，以环境变量为准 |
| 磁盘空间 | 建议预留 ≥ 1 GB | 整个项目目录约 429 MiB：WebM 产物约 203 MiB + 精灵图缓存约 217 MiB + 临时/配置等；若本地素材源也要下载，另需约 1.4 GiB |

无需执行 `npm install`：脚本只使用 Node.js 内置模块，ffmpeg 是可执行文件依赖。

## 快速开始

### 方式一：一键安装（推荐）

在项目根目录打开 PowerShell：

```powershell
cd "pamper"
.\install.ps1
```

如果系统执行策略拦截脚本：

```powershell
powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File .\install.ps1
```

`install.ps1` 会依次：检查 Node.js / ffmpeg、解析 `DSH_HOME` → `node scripts/build.mjs`（5 步构建）→ `node scripts/install.mjs` → 打印安装结果与后续步骤。失败时以非 0 退出码退出并给出中文错误。

安装完成后：

1. **刷新 DSH 页面**（浏览器端 Ctrl+F5）。此时**默认只会看到内置的蓝毛小女仆一只**（本机 `main` 当前配置为仅桌面）；8 个新 pack 的 `display` 都是 `none`，所以不会自动出现。
2. **启用形象**：打开 **设置 → 桌宠配置**，「种类」条里能看到 8 个新种类；选中想看的种类（如 `aboutme-dragon`），在「宠物配置」把 **显示位置** 从「都不显示」改成 **仅桌面 / 仅浏览器 / 两者**，点「保存」。桌面端保存后 Helper 会重载，对应的宠物窗口/overlay 随即出现；可对多个种类重复此步骤。
3. **可选：加「退出回家」**（见[进阶用法 → 退出回家补丁](#退出回家补丁patch-dsh-petmjs)）：`node scripts/patch-dsh-pet.mjs`，之后右键任意宠物就有「退出回家」，点一下只让这一只退出。
4. 桌面模式（Electron 透明窗）如果连内置小女仆都没出现：在宠物上**右键 →「重载配置」**；仍不显示时完全退出并重启 DSH。

### 方式二：分步执行

```powershell
# 1. 构建：商店目录 → 精灵图 → 透明 WebM → aboutme 配置 → 小小桌宠规范化 → 汇总清单
node scripts/build.mjs

# 2. 安装：校验并把 dist\pet\aboutme-* 与 xiaoxiao-* 复制到 %DSH_HOME%\dsh-pet\pet\
node scripts/install.mjs
```

首次构建需要下载/转换素材并逐个转码，耗时取决于网络与 CPU；`dist\pet\` 下会生成 8 组 `-config.json` / `-animation\`，xiaoxiao 系列另有 `-avatar.png`。

只想重建小小桌宠那一步：

```powershell
node scripts/build-xiaoxiao-packs.mjs
```

### 方式三：优先看预览（不安装）

```powershell
node scripts/serve.mjs
# aboutme 4 形象精灵图舞台：  http://127.0.0.1:8899/preview/
# 8 个新形象本地 WebM 卡片：   http://127.0.0.1:8899/preview/all-characters.html
```

两个预览页都不影响已安装的宠物：

- **`preview/`（aboutme 精灵图舞台）**：从 CDN 直接加载精灵图，用 canvas 播放 **4 个 aboutme 形象**（内置蓝毛小女仆 + 白龙娘 + 橙发书娘 + 紫发猫耳娘），可拖拽、缩放、点击回应；数据来自 `preview/manifest.json`（由 `build-configs.mjs` 生成），全新克隆需先跑一次 `node scripts/build.mjs`。
- **`preview/all-characters.html`（全部形象预览）**：读取 `dist/manifest.json` 与各 pack 的配置，直接播放 `dist/pet/*-animation/*.webm` 的**本地**透明 WebM，展示 8 个新 pack（aboutme 3 + xiaoxiao 5）的卡片，每张卡片可「换动作 / 回到待机」，并显示动画数、尺寸、display 与默认角落。它需要先完成构建，且必须通过 HTTP 打开（`file://` 无法加载 WebM/manifest）。

![全部形象预览](preview/all-characters-shot.png)

### 安装脚本参数

| 参数 | 作用 |
| --- | --- |
| `-SkipBuild` | 跳过构建，直接用现有 `dist\pet` 产物安装 |
| `-All` | 全量转换（aboutme 不做动作上限截断，体积/耗时大） |
| `-Force` | 构建时强制重新下载/重转，安装时覆盖同名 pack |
| `-DryRun` | 只打印将要复制的文件，不实际写入 |
| `-Target <dir>` | 安装到自定义目录（默认 `%DSH_HOME%\dsh-pet\pet`） |

> 想跳过「小小桌宠」5 个角色时，直接用分步命令：`node scripts/build.mjs --skip-xiaoxiao`。

## 多形象同屏与管理

### 启用形象（默认 display=none）

8 个新 pack 安装后全都是 **`display=none`（都不显示）**，所以默认只会看到内置的蓝毛小女仆一只。显示某个形象：

1. 打开 **设置 → 桌宠配置**。
2. 在「种类」条里点选目标种类（如 `aboutme-dragon` / `xiaoxiao-bailong`）。
3. 在「宠物配置」里把 **显示位置** 从「都不显示」改成 **仅桌面 / 仅浏览器 / 两者** 之一。
4. 点底部 **「保存」**。桌面端会重载 Helper，对应的宠物窗口随即出现；浏览器端刷新页面即可在 overlay 里看到。

可以对多个种类分别启用；想全部开启也可以逐个设置。`display=none` 不影响「种类」与宠物列表的可见性，随时可以再改回来。

### 加一只实例（同屏多只）

8 个 pack 各带 1 只实例，加上 dsh-pet 内置的小女仆，共 9 个形象（全部启用后可同屏）。想再加一只（例如再放一只白毛小龙娘）：

1. 打开 **设置 → 桌宠配置**。
2. 在「种类」条里点选目标种类，例如 `xiaoxiao-bailong`。
3. 在「宠物列表」下方点 **「添加宠物」**（`+`），会在该种类下新建一只实例。
4. 设置 **名字**、**大小（宽度 px）**、**显示位置**（仅浏览器 / 仅桌面 / 两者 / 都不显示）、**位置**（四角）与 **水平/垂直偏移**。
5. 按需打开 **余额功能 / 碎碎念 / 工作状态联动 / 宠物固定** 四个开关；「人设」留空即跟随该种类的默认人设。
6. 点底部 **「保存」**，即时生效（桌面端会重载宠物窗口）。

> 同一个种类可以加任意多只实例；不同种类之间互不影响。设置页保存时，各类实例会写回各自的 `<前缀>-config.json`，不会混进 `main-config.jsonc`。

### 显示位置（display）

| 值 | 含义 |
| --- | --- |
| `none` | 都不显示（**本项目 8 个 pack 的默认值**；种类与实例仍保留，随时可开启） |
| `web` | 仅浏览器页面内（overlay） |
| `desktop` | 仅桌面模式（Electron 透明窗） |
| `both` | 两者都显示 |

- 单只实例的 `size` 是宽度 px，高度自动按 9:16 计算；aboutme 默认 420，xiaoxiao 默认 300–320（按四角分散摆放，与 420 px 形象错开）。
- 想固定不动：打开「宠物固定」（`fixedEnabled`），只影响随机动画链，右键点播和事件动画不受影响。
- 「仅桌面」会为每个实例开一个 Electron 透明窗；只想在页面里看时选「仅浏览器」，避免一次开太多窗口。

### 让某个形象出现在桌面模式 / 浏览器

- **临时/单实例**：直接按上面「启用形象」在设置页改该实例的显示位置并保存（写回该 pack 的 config）。
- **永久改默认值**：编辑 `config/xiaoxiao.mjs`（xiaoxiao）或 `config/characters.mjs`（aboutme）里对应角色的 `display` / `size` / `position`，重新构建并安装：
  - aboutme：`node scripts/build.mjs --skip-fetch` → `node scripts/install.mjs --force`
  - xiaoxiao：`node scripts/build-xiaoxiao-packs.mjs` → `node scripts/install.mjs --force`
- 注意：重新安装会覆盖安装目录里的 pack 配置，**随后又回到新配置里的 display 值**（默认 none）。日常开关用设置页即可。

### 移除形象

- **只删一只实例**：设置页选中该实例 → 删除 → 保存。删掉某个种类的最后一只实例后，种类本身仍存在（可在「种类」条里再加回来）。
- **彻底卸载本项目安装的形象**：

```powershell
# 先预览将删除的绝对路径
.\uninstall.ps1 -WhatIf

# 确认后执行（只删 pet\aboutme-*、pet\xiaoxiao-* 的 config / animation / avatar）
.\uninstall.ps1
```

`uninstall.ps1` 只匹配 `aboutme-*` 与 `xiaoxiao-*`，绝不会删除 dsh-pet 自带的 `main-config.jsonc` 或其它 `<名>-config.json`。也可以手动删除 `%DSH_HOME%\dsh-pet\pet\` 下对应的 `aboutme-*` / `xiaoxiao-*` 文件与目录。卸载后刷新页面。

> 卸载 dsh-pet 插件本体与删除用户数据是两件事：本项目只管理 pet pack。插件本体请用 DSH 的插件管理卸载（设置页「卸载与存储」给出了命令 `dsh plugin --profile <profile> remove dsh-pet`）。

- 「宠爱」页的**角色页**：右上角是官方同款圆形「刷新」图标 + 深色「＋ 添加角色 ▾」按钮；副标题为「一碗碗大米饭就是对你的宠爱…」；「角色 / 桌宠配置」为胶囊分段切换。统计栏保持**一行**：**「N 位角色 · M 个正在桌面陪伴」**（随开关实时变化）+「刷新列表 / 全部开启 / 全部隐藏」三个按钮（白底描边，鼠标悬停变黑底白字，点击即执行）。每个角色一张预览卡（角色图 + 「N 个动作 · 独立角色项目」+ 右上角「详情」文字链），**三列网格**、可纵向滚动；与官方插件页一致的开关（40×22 胶囊轨道 + 18px 白色圆形圆钮；开启=深黑轨道，关闭=浅灰轨道，0.2s 平滑滑动）控制显示（开启 = 只在桌面显示并只开该角色第一只实例，关闭 = 全部实例隐藏），卡片左上角显示「已隐藏」。点「详情」会切到「桌宠配置」并自动选中这个角色。
- 「宠爱」页的**桌宠配置页**：与「设置 → 桌宠配置」完全同一套页面，功能不变（分组、实例、大小、位置、显示方式、保存等），宽度自适应页面。
## 发现：动作按需加载（dsh-pamper 插件）

除了「角色 / 桌宠配置」，宠爱页新增 **「发现」** 第三页：从 `assets/pet-store/` 的完整动作库（4 角色 / 6 动作包 / **819 个动作**：小女仆 268、白龙娘 285、橙发书娘 166、紫发猫耳娘 100）里挑动作，按需转成透明 WebM 并加载进对应形象。

- **动作库与已安装分离**：`assets/pet-store/` 保存原始精灵图；未加载的动作不转换、不安装，只出现在发现页。
- **三种加载粒度**：单个动作、整分类（「加载本分类」）、整角色（「加载该角色全部」）；已加载的动作显示为「已加载」并禁用按钮。
- **按需转换**：点击加载时由本地插件调用 ffmpeg 把精灵图转成 VP9 透明 WebM（单个动作约 10–60 秒，长动作更久），写入对应 pack 的 animation 目录并合并 config，最后自动通知 dsh-pet 重载。
- **小女仆 = 大肥鱼**：动作库里的小女仆就是主形象「大肥鱼」，不再单独创建 `aboutme-maid`；发现页加载小女仆动作会直接写进 main（`main-config.jsonc` + `main-animation/`），同一角色只保留一个形象。

发现页的后端是项目内的小型 DSH host 插件 `plugins/dsh-pamper/`（注册 `/dsh-pamper-7462/*` 路由）。安装一次即可：

## 构建流程

```
本地素材源（默认 D:\PC\DSH\桌面宠物源代码）     网络（本地缺失时才用）
  pet素材\  ──────────────────────────────┐      jsDelivr → raw.githubusercontent
  xiaoxiao-zhuochong桌面源代码\            │
        │                                  ▼
        │            catalog/ + assets/spritesheet-cache/   ① fetch-catalog / ② fetch-assets
        │                                  │
        │                                  ▼
        │            dist/pet/aboutme-*-animation/*.webm     ③ convert-spritesheets（CRF 20）
        │                                  │
        │                                  ▼
        │            dist/pet/aboutme-*-config.json           ④ build-configs（选材 + preview/manifest.json）
        ▼
dist/pet/xiaoxiao-*-animation/*.webm + *-config.json + *-avatar.png   ⑤ build-xiaoxiao-packs（CRF 28，640×360）
        │
        ▼
dist/manifest.json（8 个 pack 的动画数 / 字节数 / 位置 / display 汇总）
        │  install.mjs 校验必填段、动画文件与实例 id 后复制
        ▼
%DSH_HOME%\dsh-pet\pet\  （aboutme 3 + xiaoxiao 5，共 8 个 pack）
        │  dsh-pet 扫描 pet\ 目录
        ▼
DSH 设置页「桌宠配置 → 种类」多出 8 个种类（默认 display=none）；到设置页启用后才显示，最多 9 个形象同屏
```

各步骤细节：

1. **fetch-catalog**：先读本地 `pet素材\pets.json` 与各包清单；本地文件缺失才走 CDN/raw。
2. **fetch-assets**：只下载/复制「会被打包」的精灵图（webp + 同名 json 元数据）到 `assets/spritesheet-cache/`。
3. **convert-spritesheets**：按 8 列网格逐帧裁切，`libvpx-vp9` + `yuva420p` 编码为透明 WebM（默认 CRF 20）。
4. **build-configs**：按 `config/characters.mjs` 选材生成 aboutme 配置、`preview/manifest.json`。
5. **build-xiaoxiao-packs**：读 `config/xiaoxiao.mjs`，从本地小小桌宠 `characters/<角色>/config.json` 取动画池，只保留动画目录里真实存在的名字，把源 WebM（1280×720 / 1280×960）统一缩放并补边为 **640×360 透明 WebM（CRF 28）**，同时复制 `android\assets\<角色>\portrait.png` 为 `<kind>-avatar.png`。
6. **writeDistManifest**：扫描 `dist/pet` 汇总 `dist/manifest.json`。

## 脚本与参数速查

所有脚本在项目根目录执行：`node scripts\<脚本名>.mjs [参数]`。

| 脚本 | 作用 | 参数 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `fetch-catalog.mjs` | 抓取商店目录（本地优先，缺失才联网） | `--force` 已缓存也重下 |
| `fetch-assets.mjs` | 下载/复制被选中动作的精灵图与元数据到 `assets/spritesheet-cache/` | `--all`、`--force`、`--jobs=N`（默认 4） |
| `convert-spritesheets.mjs` | aboutme 精灵图 → 透明 WebM | `--all`、`--force`、`--crf=N`（默认 20）、`--jobs=N`（默认 4） |
| `build-configs.mjs` | 生成 aboutme pet pack 配置与预览/构建清单（不生成 WebM） | `--all` |
| `build-xiaoxiao-packs.mjs` | 小小桌宠 5 角色：规范化 WebM、生成配置、复制头像 | `--force`、`--crf=N`（默认 28）、`--jobs=N`（默认 6） |
| `build.mjs` | 一键构建 ①→⑤ 并汇总清单 | `--all`、`--force`、`--crf=N`、`--jobs=N`、`--skip-fetch`、`--skip-convert`、`--skip-config`、`--skip-xiaoxiao`、`--help` |
| `install.mjs` | 校验并安装全部 8 个 pack（含 xiaoxiao 头像） | `--dry-run`、`--force`、`--target=<dir>` |
| `uninstall.mjs` | 只删目标目录的 `aboutme-*` / `xiaoxiao-*`（config / animation / avatar） | `--dry-run`、`--target=<dir>`、`--purge-dist` |
| `patch-dsh-pet.mjs` | 运行期补丁：宠爱入口 / 型号分组 / 改名 / 退出回家（幂等，插件升级后需重跑） | `--check`、`--revert`、`--package=<dir>` |
| `serve.mjs` | 本地静态服务器（预览页） | `--port=8899`（默认 8899）、`--root=<dir>`（默认项目根） |

- `--crf` 默认 20 只作用于 aboutme；小小桌宠步骤默认固定 28。若显式传 `--crf=<其它值>`，该值也会用于小小桌宠（例如 `--crf=24` 会让两步都用 24）。
- `--jobs` 对 aboutme 的下载/转换默认 4；小小桌宠转码固定按 6 并发（`build-xiaoxiao-packs.mjs --jobs=N` 可单独调）。
- 除 `fetch-catalog.mjs` 外，其余脚本都支持 `--help`；`fetch-catalog.mjs` 只有 `--force` 一个参数。

`package.json` 另提供了一组 npm 别名（无需 `npm install`，只是少打几个字）：

| 命令 | 等价于 |
| --- | --- |
| `npm run build` | `node scripts/build.mjs` |
| `npm run build:all` | `node scripts/build.mjs --all` |
| `npm run fetch` | `node scripts/fetch-catalog.mjs` |
| `npm run install:packs` | `node scripts/install.mjs` |
| `npm run uninstall:packs` | `node scripts/uninstall.mjs` |
| `npm run preview` | `node scripts/serve.mjs` |

## 进阶用法

### 修改 aboutme 动作（白龙娘 / 橙发书娘 / 紫发猫耳娘）

动作不是写死在脚本里的，而是由 `config/characters.mjs` 的选材规则决定：

- **点名某个动作**：把动作名写进该形象的 `random.pick` 数组，例如 `random: { max: 18, perCategory: 2, categories: [...], pick: ['用龙尾拍打地面', '白龙现世'] }`。`pick` 里的动作会按名字在 `sources` 里查找并追加到随机小动作池（分组到它原本的分类）；名字不用考虑 Windows 非法字符，构建时会自动安全化。注意它是在分类抽样之后追加的，**不受 `random.max` 限制**，且如果该动作已被必需池占用则会被跳过。
- **把某个分类优先纳入**：在该形象（或 `PREVIEW_ONLY_CHARACTERS` 里的预览形象）的 `random.categories` 数组里加上分类名。写在前面的分类优先挑，没列到的分类按动作数量从多到少补。
- **增加随机小动作数量**：调大 `random.max`（默认 18）与 `random.perCategory`（默认 2）。注意动作越多，下载/转码/安装体积越大。
- **换素材来源包**：改 `sources`（`pack` 为商店包名，`essential: true` 表示优先提供必需动作；`essential: false` 的包只补充随机小动作）。
- **一次纳入全部动作**：用 `--all` 全量构建（不截断），等价于把 `random.max`/`perCategory` 设为无限。
- 改完 `config/characters.mjs` 后重新执行 `node scripts/build.mjs`（或加 `--skip-fetch` 跳过已下载部分）再 `node scripts/install.mjs`。

### 调整小小桌宠角色

- 角色映射、尺寸、默认位置、`display` 都在 `config/xiaoxiao.mjs`；改完先 `node scripts/build-xiaoxiao-packs.mjs`（必要时加 `--force` 重转），再 `node scripts/install.mjs --force`。
- 动画池来自上游 `characters/<source>/config.json` 的 `animations`；本项目只做规范化（丢弃素材里不存在的名字、补齐 `events.balance`、重算权重），**不新增动画**。想给角色加动作需要在上游项目里补素材。
- 人设取自上游 `人设.json` 首段（写进 pack 的 `whisperPrompt`）；xiaoxiao 默认 `whisperEnabled=false`，所以人设只作为设置页可编辑的默认值。
- 换角色头像：把上游 `android\assets\<source>\portrait.png` 换成新图后重新构建；或直接在 `dist\pet` 里替换 `<kind>-avatar.png` 后重新安装。
- 想换本地素材源位置：设置环境变量 `DESKTOP_PET_SOURCE_ROOT`（默认 `D:\PC\DSH\桌面宠物源代码`），两个上游目录名保持不变。

### 修改默认显示方式（display）

8 个 pack 默认 `display=none`。想永久修改某形象的默认显示方式（而不是每次在设置页点）：

- aboutme：编辑 `config/characters.mjs` 里对应角色的 `display`（`none` / `web` / `desktop` / `both`）、`size`、`position`，然后 `node scripts/build.mjs --skip-fetch` + `node scripts/install.mjs --force`；
- xiaoxiao：编辑 `config/xiaoxiao.mjs` 里对应角色的同名字段，然后 `node scripts/build-xiaoxiao-packs.mjs` + `node scripts/install.mjs --force`。

> 重新构建安装会覆盖安装目录里的 pack 配置，因此 display 会回到新默认值；日常开关建议用设置页（设置页的修改会写回该 pack 的 config，重新安装前一直有效）。
> 桌面模式会为每只 `display` 含 desktop 的宠物各开一个 Electron 透明窗，窗口多时占用明显；只想在页面里看就选 `web`/`both`。

### 退出回家补丁（patch-dsh-pet.mjs）

dsh-pet 原生右键菜单没有「退出这一只」的快捷项。`scripts/patch-dsh-pet.mjs` 给**已安装的 dsh-pet** 补一个「退出回家」菜单项（桌面透明窗 + 网页 overlay 两处都生效）：

```powershell
# 应用补丁（幂等，已打过会跳过）
node scripts/patch-dsh-pet.mjs

# 只看状态
node scripts/patch-dsh-pet.mjs --check

# 从备份还原
node scripts/patch-dsh-pet.mjs --revert
```

行为与细节：

- 点击「退出回家」= 把**这一只**宠物的 `display` 写成 `none`（复用 dsh-pet 自带「显示位置 → 都不显示」的同一套写配置通道），窗口/overlay 只退出这一只，其它宠物不受影响；之后可在「设置 → 桌宠配置」把「显示位置」改回来。
- 改动文件（首次修改前会生成 `.dshpet-backup` 备份）：
  - `<dsh-pet>\runtime\electron-helper\sprite\menu.js`（桌面右键菜单）
  - `<dsh-pet>\lib\client.js`（网页 overlay 右键菜单）
- 幂等：重复运行不会重复插入；`--check` 只检查状态、`--revert` 从备份还原两个文件。
- **dsh-pet 插件升级/重装会覆盖这两个文件，补丁会丢失，需要重新运行脚本**；升级后建议先 `--check` 确认。
- 默认从 `$DSH_PROFILE_DIR\node_modules\dsh-pet` 找包（DSH 环境/脚本会话通常会设置）；在普通终端找不到时用 `--package` 指到你的 profile：

```powershell
node scripts/patch-dsh-pet.mjs --package="$env:DSH_HOME\profiles\<profile>\node_modules\dsh-pet"
```

- 打完后重载 dsh-pet 生效：桌面模式右键宠物 →「重载配置」，浏览器刷新页面。

### 全量转换（体积换完整度）

```powershell
node scripts/build.mjs --all
```

aboutme 来源动作包的小动作基本全部纳入（专用池仍有上限）；小小桌宠不受 `--all` 影响（它由上游 config.json 决定，本来就只有现成动作）。以白龙娘为例，`gpt1 + gpt` 来源合计 285 个动作，转换耗时与磁盘占用都会明显增加。

### 调整画质与并发

- `--crf=N`：VP9 质量，默认 20（aboutme）/ 28（xiaoxiao）。数字越小越清晰、文件越大；24~28 可明显减小体积。
- `--jobs=N`：下载与 ffmpeg 转码并发，默认 4（aboutme）；xiaoxiao 转码默认 6，可用 `build-xiaoxiao-packs.mjs --jobs=N` 单独调整。

### 分段构建

```powershell
node scripts/fetch-catalog.mjs             # 只抓目录（本地优先）
node scripts/fetch-assets.mjs --all        # 只下载/复制精灵图
node scripts/convert-spritesheets.mjs      # 只转 aboutme WebM
node scripts/build-configs.mjs             # 只生成 aboutme 配置（会校验 WebM 是否齐全）
node scripts/build-xiaoxiao-packs.mjs      # 只规范化小小桌宠 5 角色
```

`build.mjs` 也支持 `--skip-fetch` / `--skip-convert` / `--skip-config` / `--skip-xiaoxiao` 跳过对应阶段。

### 预览页

```powershell
node scripts/serve.mjs            # http://127.0.0.1:8899/preview/
node scripts/serve.mjs --port=9000
```

- `preview/`：读取 `preview/manifest.json`（由 `build-configs.mjs` 生成），从 CDN 直接加载精灵图，可在不安装的情况下检查 aboutme 4 个形象（内置 + 3 个新形象）的动作与外观。
- `preview/all-characters.html`：读取 `dist/manifest.json` 与 `dist/pet/*-config.json`，直接播放构建产物里的本地透明 WebM，8 个新 pack 各一张卡片；顶部徽标显示 pack 数，卡片可换动作。构建后访问 `http://127.0.0.1:8899/preview/all-characters.html`。
- 截图：`preview/all-characters-shot.png`（全部形象预览）、`preview/preview-shot.png`（aboutme 精灵图舞台）。

### 安装到其它位置 / 其它 DSH_HOME

```powershell
node scripts/install.mjs --target="D:\dsh-pet\pet"
.\install.ps1 -Target "D:\dsh-pet\pet"
```

安装脚本只复制 `aboutme-*` / `xiaoxiao-*` 前缀的文件与目录，`--force` 用于覆盖已存在的同名前缀 pack（并先清空同名 `-animation\` 目录）。

### 清理缓存与产物

| 路径 | 内容 | 清理方式 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `assets\spritesheet-cache\` | 下载的 aboutme 精灵图与元数据（约 217 MiB） | 可安全删除，下次构建重新下载/复制 |
| `dist\pet\` | 8 个 pack 的 WebM、配置与头像（约 203 MiB） | `node scripts/uninstall.mjs --purge-dist` 或手动删除，下次重新构建 |
| `.build-tmp\` | 构建临时文件 | 可安全删除 |
| 本地素材源 | 外部只读引用，不属于本项目产物 | 不要删（构建要用） |

想强制重建某一步时优先用 `--force`，它会重下/重转但不会清空整个缓存。

## 故障排查

排障第一步永远是看插件日志：`%DSH_HOME%\dsh-pet\logs.txt`（桌面版没有控制台，启动、崩溃、配置告警都在这）。设置页「卸载与存储」也直接列出了这个路径。

### 装完宠物不出现 / 种类里没有新形象

1. 确认文件真的落地了：`%DSH_HOME%\dsh-pet\pet\` 下应有 8 组 `aboutme-*-config.json` / `xiaoxiao-*-config.json` 与对应的 `-animation\` 目录（xiaoxiao 另有 `-avatar.png`）。
2. 确认 `DSH_HOME` 一致：脚本与 DSH 进程读的是同一个 `.dsh` 目录。若你手动设置过 `DSH_HOME`，重新打开终端让安装脚本继承它。
3. **刷新页面**；桌面模式在宠物上右键 →「重载配置」；仍不行则完全退出并重启 DSH。
4. 看 `logs.txt`：若出现「文件宠物配置解析失败，已跳过」或字段告警，说明某个 `-config.json` 内容被改坏，重新执行 `node scripts/install.mjs --force`。
5. 设置页「种类」条只列出插件成功扫描到的配置文件；`.json` 必须能被严格 JSON 解析（不能有注释/尾逗号）。

### 装了但看不到新形象（display=none）

8 个新 pack 默认 `display=none`，安装后**本来就不显示**，只会看到内置小女仆一只。处理：

1. 打开 **设置 → 桌宠配置 → 种类**，确认 8 个种类都在（在就说明安装成功）；
2. 选中想看的种类，把「显示位置」从「都不显示」改成 仅桌面/仅浏览器/两者，点「保存」；
3. 桌面模式仍不出现：在宠物上右键 →「重载配置」，或重启 DSH；浏览器端刷新页面；
4. 仍不行看 `%DSH_HOME%\dsh-pet\logs.txt` 是否有配置告警，并确认 `DSH_HOME` 与 DSH 进程一致。

### 右键没有「退出回家」

该菜单项来自 `scripts/patch-dsh-pet.mjs`，不是 dsh-pet 原生功能：

- **dsh-pet 刚升级/重装过** → 补丁被覆盖，重新运行 `node scripts/patch-dsh-pet.mjs`，再用 `--check` 确认两个文件都是 patched/already；
- 运行后重载生效：桌面模式右键宠物 →「重载配置」，浏览器刷新页面；
- 找不到 dsh-pet 包时用 `--package="$env:DSH_HOME\profiles\<profile>\node_modules\dsh-pet"` 显式指定；
- 想恢复原生菜单：`node scripts/patch-dsh-pet.mjs --revert`。

### 构建时提示找不到小小桌宠素材

报错形如「找不到素材目录 …\xiaoxiao-zhuochong桌面源代码\characters\…」。处理：

- 确认本地素材源存在，或设置 `DESKTOP_PET_SOURCE_ROOT` 指向正确目录；
- 确认目录结构是 `xiaoxiao-zhuochong桌面源代码\characters\<角色>\animations\*.webm` 与 `android\assets\<角色>\portrait.png`；
- xiaoxiao 素材**没有网络回退**，必须本地存在；只想构建 aboutme 时可用 `node scripts/build.mjs --skip-xiaoxiao`。

### 宠物出现了但动画不播放 / 资源 404

- dsh-pet 的动画名 = 配置里的字符串 = 素材文件名（不含扩展名），**必须完全一致**（含中文、空格、符号）。
- WebM 必须直接放在 `pet\<前缀>-animation\` 下，不能多套一层子目录。
- aboutme 配置由脚本生成、xiaoxiao 只保留真实存在的名字，正常不会 404；如手改过安装目录里的配置，重新安装即可恢复一致。
- 只要 `pet\<前缀>-animation\` 目录存在，dsh-pet 就**只查这个目录**，不会回落到插件自带素材；缺一个文件就是缺一个动作。

### 头像不显示 / 对话里是默认图

- xiaoxiao 系列安装后应在 pet 目录里有 `<kind>-avatar.png`；缺了重新执行 `node scripts/install.mjs --force`。
- dsh-pet 按 `<素材根>-avatar.<ext>`（png/webp/jpg/jpeg/gif）查找自定义头像；`main` 条目永远用插件包内 logo，aboutme 系列没有配置头像，回退包内 logo。
- 头像文件损坏/尺寸异常时 dsh-pet 会回退默认图，替换后刷新页面即可。

### 预览页打不开 / 卡片全黑 / 加载失败

- `preview/all-characters.html` 依赖**构建产物**：需要 `dist/manifest.json` 与 `dist/pet/*-animation/*.webm` 存在；干净克隆请先 `node scripts/build.mjs`。
- 两个预览页都**必须通过 HTTP 打开**：在项目根执行 `node scripts/serve.mjs`，再访问 `http://127.0.0.1:8899/preview/...`。直接双击 HTML（`file://`）时浏览器会拦截 manifest/WebM 的读取。
- `preview/` 还依赖 `preview/manifest.json`（`build-configs.mjs` 生成）；缺失时页面会给出失败原因并显示兜底数据。
- 端口被占用时用 `node scripts/serve.mjs --port=9000`，访问地址的端口同步改。

### WebM 透明背景变黑底

Chrome / Edge / Firefox 与桌面模式支持 VP9-alpha；**Safari 及部分 WebView 不支持 VP9 的 alpha 通道**，会显示黑底。请换浏览器，或使用 dsh-pet 的桌面模式（Electron 窗口）。dsh-pet 的 `.mov`（HEVC-alpha）方案不随 npm 包发布，本项目不生成 mov。

### 构建失败

| 报错/现象 | 原因与处理 |
| --- | --- |
| `找不到 ffmpeg` / `fin

# dsh-vps

把 DeepSeek Harness 装进你的 VPS：一条命令，公网可达，界面原样

Your DeepSeek Harness on your own VPS — one command, reachable from anywhere, native UI intact

简体中文 · English

--- > **这是 DSH 的 VPS 部署工具：把带登录界面的原版 DSH 装到你自己的 VPS 上，之后在任何地方用浏览器访问。** 两种装法任选其一： **① 在自己电脑上的 DSH 里填表安装**：插件市场搜索 `dsh-vps` 安装（或执行 `dsh plugin add dsh-vps`），打开「设置 → VPS 部署」，填服务器 IP、SSH 端口、用户名，选登录方式（密码 / 私钥 / 本机密钥），有域名再填域名，点「安装到这台 VPS」。 **② 在 VPS 上执行一键安装命令**： ```bash curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/AIcivilization/dsh-vps/main/install.sh | sudo bash -s ``` 有域名、在国内网络时，在末尾追加参数，例如 `bash -s -- --domain dsh.example.com --mirror cn`，详见下方[安装](#安装)。 --- ## 简介 [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness)（DSH）默认只认本机浏览器：它的特权接口（设置、API Key、插件管理）受浏览器信任围栏保护，直接反代到公网后这些页面全部失效。 dsh-vps 用一个零运行时依赖的登录网关（dsh-gate）架在 DSH 前面：公网请求先过 scrypt 登录门，再由网关以服务端身份完成 DSH 会话认证并透传。你在任何地方打开浏览器，用的都是官方原版的 DSH Web 界面，设置、模型、API Key、插件市场该有的都有。 DeepSeek Harness (DSH) trusts the operator's own browser only: its privileged interfaces — settings, API keys, plugin management — sit behind a browser-trust fence, and a plain reverse proxy to the public internet leaves those pages dead. dsh-vps puts a zero-dependency login gateway (dsh-gate) in front of DSH: public requests pass a scrypt login gate first, then the gateway performs DSH session authentication server-side and proxies the rest. You open a browser anywhere and get the stock DSH web interface — settings, models, API keys and the plugin marketplace all working. --- ## 能力一览 | 能力 | 说明 | | --- | --- | | 两种装法 | 在自己电脑上的 DSH 里填表、点一下安装（Mac / Windows / Linux）；或在 VPS 上执行一条 `curl \| bash`。装完即 systemd 托管、开机自启 | | 登录门 | scrypt 口令 + HMAC 会话 Cookie + 登录限流；「保持登录」默认勾选，30 天内免登录；「设置 → VPS 部署 → 本机状态」里可修改密码（需当前密码，改后其他设备自动退出） | | 添加到手机桌面 | 「设置 → VPS 部署 → 本机状态」里扫码，在手机上把 DSH 当作应用添加到主屏幕，全屏打开、像原生应用一样使用 | | 浏览器初始向导 | 管理员账号、域名、DeepSeek API Key、预置插件，全程在浏览器里填完 | | 中英双语 | 登录页、初始向导、启动等待页按浏览器语言显示中文或英文，右上角可手动切换并记住；DSH 内的「VPS 部署」页与升级提示条跟随 DSH 的语言设置 | | 一次性启动令牌 | 向导只对持有令牌的人开放，链接随安装输出，`dsh-vps setup-url` 可重取，设置完成即作废 | | 预置插件一键装 | 向导内置 3 款：本产品的设置页 dsh-vps（必装），以及插件市场与 VPS 管理（默认勾选、可取消）；后台装完自动重启生效 | | 自动 HTTPS | Caddy 自动签发并续期证书；向导里改域名即时热加载 | | 公网可用的原生设置页 | 设置、模型、API Key、权限策略在公网域名下照常读写 | | 插件市场可用 | 市场里浏览/安装插件，点「立即重启」直接生效 | | 会话自愈 | DSH 首启与插件安装需要几十秒，页面自动等待，就绪后自动进入 | | 跟随官方一键升级 | DSH 出新版本时页面提示，在「设置 → VPS 部署」里点一下升级；升级走备份 → 自检 → 失败自动回滚，也可随时手动回滚 | | 可观测与可恢复 | 本机 `/gate/health` 直接给出崩溃原因与连续崩溃次数；`dsh-vps backup` 保留最近 3 份 | | 收紧的暴露面 | 会话 Cookie 恒为 Secure/HttpOnly/SameSite；诊断接口只对服务器本机与已登录会话开放；服务以无特权的 dsh 用户运行并受 systemd 沙箱约束 | --- ## 截图

展开查看 12 张原图（DSH 里的「VPS 部署」页 → 安装 → 向导 → 设置完成 → 登录 → DSH 界面 → 设置 → 插件市场）
| 在 DSH 里填表安装到 VPS | 从 VPS 卸载 | VPS 上的「本机状态」 | | :---: | :---: | :---: | | ![](docs/screenshots/00a-deploy-install.webp) | ![](docs/screenshots/00b-deploy-uninstall.webp) | ![](docs/screenshots/00c-deploy-status.webp) | | 安装完成 | 初始设置向导 | 向导已填写 | | :---: | :---: | :---: | | ![](docs/screenshots/01-install.png) | ![](docs/screenshots/02-setup.png) | ![](docs/screenshots/03-setup-filled.png) | | 设置完成 | 登录门 | 登录 | | :---: | :---: | :---: | | ![](docs/screenshots/04-setup-done.png) | ![](docs/screenshots/05-login.png) | ![](docs/screenshots/06-login-filled.png) | | DSH 原生界面 | 设置（公网域名下可用） | 插件市场 | | :---: | :---: | :---: | | ![](docs/screenshots/07-dsh.png) | ![](docs/screenshots/08-settings.png) | ![](docs/screenshots/09-market.png) |
--- ## 环境要求 - Ubuntu 22.04+ / Debian 12+（root） - 2C2G 以上，端口 80/443 开放 - 有域名即可自动 HTTPS（先把 A 记录解析到本机）；暂无域名也能先用公网 IP + 自签证书 --- ## 安装 ### 方式一：在自己电脑上的 DSH 里填表安装 Mac、Windows、Linux 上的 DSH 都可以： 1. 在 DSH 里装上插件 `dsh-vps`：插件市场搜索安装，或执行 `dsh plugin add dsh-vps` 2. 打开「设置 → VPS 部署」，填服务器 IP、SSH 端口、用户名，选登录方式；有域名（A 记录已解析到服务器）再填上域名，服务器在国内就勾上「服务器在国内」 3. 点「安装到这台 VPS」 - 登录方式三选一：**密码**；**私钥**（粘贴或选择云厂商给的 .pem / 自己的 id_ed25519，可带口令）；**本机密钥**（一键生成专用密钥，复制公钥或那行命令到云厂商控制台的网页终端执行一次，~/.ssh 里已有的密钥也会一并尝试）。服务器关掉了密码登录（重装系统后常见）时用后两种 - 密码、私钥只用这一次，不保存；本机密钥的私钥只留在这台电脑上 - 页面实时显示安装日志，完成后直接给出设置向导的链接 - 安装在服务器上后台运行，中途关掉页面或网络断开都不影响 - 需要本机有 OpenSSH 客户端：Mac、Linux 自带；Windows 10/11 在「设置 → 系统 → 可选功能」里添加「OpenSSH 客户端」 ### 方式二：在 VPS 上执行一键安装命令 ```bash curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/AIcivilization/dsh-vps/main/install.sh \ | sudo bash -s -- --domain dsh.example.com ``` 国内网络加 `--mirror cn`（Node 与 DSH 走 npmmirror）： ```bash curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/AIcivilization/dsh-vps/main/install.sh \ | sudo bash -s -- --domain dsh.example.com --mirror cn ``` 还没有域名？去掉 `--domain` 即可，按公网 IP 访问： ```bash curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/AIcivilization/dsh-vps/main/install.sh | sudo bash -s ``` 此时证书由 Caddy 内置 CA 自签，浏览器会提示「不安全 / 证书不受信任」，属预期现象，选择继续访问即可。之后在向导里填上域名，Caddy 自动换成正式证书。（方式一不填域名时也是这样。） 走 npm 也行，装的是这个包自带的同一份脚本（版本固定，不联网拉取；需本机已有 Node 22+）： ```bash npx dsh-vps-install install --domain dsh.example.com ``` 想固定在某个发布版本（而非 `main`），把地址里的 `main` 换成版本 tag，并让后续拉取的网关文件也用同一版本： ```bash curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/AIcivilization/dsh-vps/v1.7.0/install.sh \ | sudo DSHVPS_RAW_BASE=https://raw.githubusercontent.com/AIcivilization/dsh-vps/v1.7.0 bash -s -- --domain dsh.example.com ``` 安装末尾的自检若报「DSH 尚未就绪」，设置链接照样会打印；页面会显示启动进度与具体错误，排障见 `journalctl -u dsh-gate -n 80 --no-pager`。 ## 更新 **新装直接是官方最新版。** 安装时取 npm 上官方最新版（与下面的升级提示同一规则：latest 与 next 中较新、发布满 12 小时）；万一装不上或装好起不来，自动退回本项目验证过的版本。想指定版本：安装命令末尾加 `--dsh <版本>`，或 `--dsh verified` 装验证过的版本。 **DSH 本身跟随官方版本升级。** 网关每 6 小时检查一次 npm 上的官方最新版（正式渠道 latest 与预览渠道 next 中较新的一个），有新版本时 DSH 页面右下角弹出提示（也可以在「设置 → VPS 部署」里查看和操作），点「立即升级」并确认即可：自动备份 → 安装新版 → 自检，自检不通过自动回滚到原版本，全程约 1–3 分钟。点「稍后」则这个版本不再提示。新版本发布满 12 小时后才会提示——上游常有“主包先发、子包几小时后才补齐”的情况，刚发布就升级只会装失败。也可以在服务器上手动执行： ```bash sudo dsh-vps upgrade # 升到本项目验证过的版本 sudo dsh-vps upgrade --latest # 升到官方最新版（与页面上的「立即升级」相同） sudo dsh-vps rollback # 切回上一个版本 ``` **网关（登录页、代理）自身的更新**： ```bash sudo dsh-vps update-gate ``` v1.5.0 之前安装的机器，重跑一次上方的一键安装命令即可获得页面升级提示（进入修复/更新模式，账号与数据保留）。 ## 卸载 ```bash curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/AIcivilization/dsh-vps/main/uninstall.sh \ | sudo bash -s -- --yes ``` **在自己电脑上的 DSH 里卸载**：「设置 → VPS 部署」→「从 VPS 卸载」，填服务器登录信息，选择是否保留 DSH 数据、是否连 Caddy 一起移除，点「从这台 VPS 卸载」。默认保留 DSH 数据。 也可以在服务器上执行上面的命令：删除服务、安装目录、Caddy 站点块与 DSH 数据目录，删除前打包备份（含 Caddyfile）到 `/root/dsh-vps-uninstall-<时间戳>.tar.gz`。安装前原有的 Caddyfile 会被还原。`--keep-data` 保留 DSH 数据，`--purge-caddy` 连 Caddy 一起移除。卸载完再跑安装命令即为全新环境。 --- ## 首次使用 安装结束时会给出一条**带一次性令牌的初始设置链接**（命令行安装打印在终端里，填表安装显示在设置页上），浏览器打开它进入向导（直接打开 IP 或域名只会看到「需要启动令牌」页，这是有意的）：填管理员用户名/密码 → （可选）域名、DeepSeek API Key 与预置插件 → 登录即用。向导只对持有令牌的人开放，令牌在设置完成后自动作废。链接丢了随时重取： ```bash sudo dsh-vps setup-url ``` API Key 跳过也无妨，登录后仍可在「添加 API Key」引导或 设置 → 模型 → DeepSeek 中补填。 插件在后台安装（约几十秒），始终取 npm 上的最新版本，装完 DSH 自动重启生效，共三款： - **dsh-vps**（本产品自带，必装）：DSH 设置里的「VPS 部署」页，分三个页签——「本机状态」（DSH 版本与一键升级、网关状态与访问方式、服务器常用命令）、「安装到 VPS」「从 VPS 卸载」（经 SSH 把 DSH 装到或卸出另一台 VPS）。装在自己电脑上的 DSH 里时只有后两个页签。界面语言跟随 DSH「设置 → 通用设置 → 语言」，目前 DSH 提供中文与英文，切换后立即生效；页面上的升级提示条同样跟随 - **dsh-pick**：插件选购顾问——说出需求，它在 DSH 生态里找候选、按去噪后的指标多维比较，给出首选 / 备选 / 不推荐，挑好直接安装。其余插件留给你自己挑：用 dsh-pick 选好装上，或在 DSH 的「插件」页安装（想要插件市场 dsh-market 也可以这样装） - **dsh-vps-manager**：在 DSH 里直接管理这台 VPS——`/vps-` 系列查询命令不经过模型、不花 token，对话内嵌终端，AI 操作按风险分级确认，另有运维菜谱库。需在 设置 → VPS Manager 中添加本机（SSH 密钥登录） --- ## 管理命令 ```bash sudo dsh-vps status # 服务状态 + 健康 + 版本提示 sudo dsh-vps restart # 重启（DSH 随之重启并自动重新兑换会话） sudo dsh-vps upgrade # 升级 DSH 到已验证版本（备份 → 自检 → 失败自动回滚） sudo dsh-vps update-gate # 拉取并重启网关自身代码（安装目录非 git 仓库，无需 git pull） sudo dsh-vps ownshost on # 应用设置页可用性补丁（公网域名下恢复设置页） sudo dsh-vps selfcheck # 跑一遍回归自检（登录 / RPC / WebSocket / 会话） sudo dsh-vps rollback # 切回上一 DSH 版本 sudo dsh-vps reset-admin # 忘记管理员密码时的应急重置（重新走向导并换发令牌，已登录的会话全部失效） sudo dsh-vps setup-url # 重新打印带一次性令牌的初始设置链接 sudo dsh-vps backup # 备份数据（保留最近 3 份） ``` Caddy 站点块由 `gate/site-block.js` 统一生成，安装与改域名共用同一份模板。 --- ## 运行机制

DSH 与网关均只绑 127.0.0.1，用户浏览器接触不到 DSH 的会话 Cookie，所有请求经网关认证后透传。 - **会话自愈**：首启与插件安装期间页面显示「DeepSeek Harness 正在启动」，按 3 秒一次自检，会话就绪后自动刷新进入。 - **设置页可用性**：DSH 前端按页面 hostname 判断是否为操作者本机浏览器，公网域名下会隐藏设置。网关随页面下发官方支持的 `__DSH_TRANSPORT__.ownsHost` 声明，设置页、模型、API Key 与权限策略随之恢复。`--trusted-host` 只负责打开网络围栏，两者是两道独立的门。 - **插件市场重启**：市场的「立即重启」由网关接管——它剥掉 Caddy 加的 `X-Forwarded-For`（该头会触发 DSH 的回环校验而 403），并由网关重启自己托管的 DSH 子进程，保证会话兑换链路不中断。 - **排障入口**：`sudo ss -ltnp | grep 3080` 查残留 DSH 进程；服务器上执行 `curl -s http://127.0.0.1:3100/gate/health` 可拿到 `lastError` / `lastExit` / `crashStreak`（该接口只对服务器本机与已登录会话开放） --- ## 仓库内容 | 文件 | 作用 | | --- | --- | | `install.sh` | 一键安装入口（唯一可选参数 `--domain`、`--mirror cn`） | | `uninstall.sh` | 卸载并备份 | | `bin/dsh-vps` | 运维命令行 | | `gate/server.js` | 登录网关（Node 原生，零依赖） | | `gate/site-block.js` | Caddy 站点块模板（安装 / 改域名共用） | | `caddy/Caddyfile.template` | Caddy 主配置 | | `units/dsh-gate.service` | systemd 单元模板 | | `versions.json` | DSH 已验证版本清单 | | `plugin/` + `cordis.patch.yml` | DSH 插件：「设置 → VPS 部署」（版本与一键升级、网关状态；或填表经 SSH 安装到 VPS） | --- ## 许可 [MIT](LICENSE)

decision.reason: Held for versioned DSH compatibility. MIT repository/package and exact npm gitHead are present. Native plugin/index.mjs mounts connection.fetch endpoints for remote install, SSH key generation and updates; related code launches SSH and installs or replaces remote services. The manifest declares Node but no versioned DSH peer/engine contract, and the captured README does not establish a DSH version range. Installer, sudo paths and remote operations were read only. No candidate code or lifecycle hooks were executed; runtime safety and compatibility are unproven.
